<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Read explicitly selected local Git-ai authorship notes as a Unisphere-supported source through the Rust SDK and thin CLI, producing source-faithful OTLP LogsData without requiring Git AI itself. Keep note attribution distinct from conversations, tool timings and retired harness telemetry.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- Consume Git-ai-format notes using standard read-only Git operations and independently implemented parsing.
- Expose commit/file/line attribution, declared agent/session identity and original provenance through existing Unisphere composition patterns.
- Make local note selection, metadata privacy, failure states and coverage limits observable through the SDK and CLI.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- No dependency on the git-ai executable, installation, library/crate, imported implementation code, daemon, HTTP backend or private cache. Git-ai is an input format only.
- No refs/harness-telemetry support, retired segment/rollup ingestion, compatibility bridge, migration or second legacy telemetry path.
- No broad repository session discovery/query/filter/extraction CLI; that is a separate plan.
- No fetch, push, sync, note mutation, hooks/config mutation, checkout/index mutation or source repository writes.
- No invented turns, token usage, duration, event timestamps, spans, authorship certainty or full-session completeness.

<a id="research-context"></a>

## Research Context

Main inspected the Git-ai format specification, parser/record definitions and actual local note blobs. Format authorship/3.0.0 has file/range attestations followed by a standalone --- divider and JSON metadata; legacy prompts, current sessions and humans can coexist. Reconnaissance and example object IDs are in assets/git-ai-reconnaissance.json. Our retired harness telemetry corpus is intentionally excluded. This is read-only evidence, not implementation approval.

<a id="risks-assumptions"></a>

## Risks & Assumptions

Git must be available or fail clearly; Git AI must not be required. Notes may be absent, malformed, oversized, changed between observations, attached to commits outside the selected history, or duplicated in tracking refs. Old and new metadata variants can share a schema version. Native checkpoint trace IDs are not OTel span IDs; note/commit timestamps are not tool execution times. Workspace handoff is explicit-path/cwd, not native-root rebinding or formal Builder dispatch.

<a id="implementation-summary"></a>

## Implementation Summary

Implemented explicit read-only git-ai-format Git Notes through pure core ports, Unix GitObjectLoader, independent mapper, injected SDK and registered dedicated CLI. Full readiness passed all six proof modes, including real external SDK/installed CLI with Git AI unavailable; SHA256 CLI smoke also passed. Source/proof manifests are in assets/verification. Independent committed-source implementation review remains pending; guide approval is not code approval. No push/merge or formal linked-worktree dispatch occurred.
